Job Description
Posted Friday, October 2, 2026 at 5:00 AM

The Sarnova Family of companies includes Digitech Computer, Bound Tree Medical, Tri-anim Health Services and Cardio Partners.

 

Digitech is a leading provider of advanced billing and technology services to the EMS transport industry. Since its founding in 1984, Digitech has refined its software platform to create a cloud-based billing and business intelligence solution that monitors and automates the entire EMS revenue lifecycle. Digitech leverages its proprietary technology to offer fully outsourced services that maximize collections, protect compliance, and deliver results for clients.

 

Summary:

 

The Software Engineer works closely with our development team and company leaders to deliver high-quality software to our users, using the latest and best coding strategies and practices.  As part of a small development team, the individual in this role will participate in program/site related development and user experience decisions and is expected to use their skills and experience to create innovative solutions.

 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

 

Develop, test, and maintain software using established programming languages, technical standards, and development methodologies
Test, analyze, and debug solutions across development, testing, and production environments
Provide production support to ensure applications operate reliably by proactively identifying issues and implementing effective solutions
Develop Proofs of Concept to evaluate the feasibility and viability of proposed technical approaches
Evaluate, recommend, and adopt new technologies that enhance product development, performance, and user experience
Collaborate closely with developers, designers, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions align with functional and user requirements
Clearly present and justify technical decisions using sound engineering judgment and fundamental programming principles
Stay current with emerging technologies, tools, and industry trends
Promote high‑quality user experiences and adherence to development best practices
Contribute to individual, departmental, and organizational initiatives as needed
Additional job duties as assigned

 

Skills/Experience Required:

 

Education: Bachelor's Degree in computer science, software engineering or related field is strongly preferred; High School Diploma and equivalent experience will be considered
1-3 years of full-stack development experience preferred
Proficiency in either C#/SQL Server or Java/MySQL Server required; other languages are beneficial
Experience in usability/interface design
Familiarity with advanced SQL queries preferred
Healthcare experience a plus
Demonstrated strong attention to detail and delivering a high quality product the first time.
Effective communication skills (verbal and written)
Exceptional time management, organization, and planning skills with proven track record of managing multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing key initiatives and hitting deadlines
Demonstrated ability to build relationships and work effectively with employees within and across departments
Highly self-motivated with a sense of urgency, bias for action and anticipatory qualities
Curious, driven to achieve and willingness to challenge the status quo
A desire to continually learn and grow in your career
Ability to independently manage all aspects of the job role including required goals and business practices in a remote environment

 

Sarnova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We offer a competitive salary, commensurate with experience, along with a comprehensive benefits package, including 401(k) Plan.  EO/M/F/Veterans/Disabled. Our mission is to be the best partner for those who save and improve patients’ lives.  Excellence in delivering upon our mission is dependent upon having a diverse team that is empowered to bring their full, authentic self to work each day.  We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve, and we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity.
